title: Pilot: slotless per-vector metering + tiered burst credits for rerank workloads (QSA prep)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: run a small, controlled pilot to evaluate a 'slotless' per-vector metering model combined with a tiered burst-credit mechanism targeted at rerank-heavy workloads. We want to measure unit economics (effective per-vector price), revenue delta versus current slab/bundle proposals, and product/ops complexity for billing and telemetry. The pilot will also produce a QSA-ready artifact set and legal language recommendations for enterprise SOWs.

Scope: two pricing arms (A = baseline per-vector slab with fixed batch discounts; B = slotless per-vector metering + time-window burst credits). Apply to 3 pilot customers (mix of search-heavy and assistant/semantic-search workloads) for a 30 day window. Metrics: net revenue per 1M vectors, average CPU/GPU token cost delta, median/95th latency, customer satisfaction (qualitative), billing accuracy errors, disputes, and ops overhead (support tickets).

Design notes:
- Slotless metering: bill exactly per-vector consumed across endpoints with fine-grained attribution to rerank calls versus indexing/embedding operations.
- Tiered burst credits: provide short-lived credit buckets (e.g., daily/hourly) that reduce price for bursts above baseline traffic; credits decay over time to avoid arbitrage.
- Enforcement: billing infra will sample and emit per-request vector counts; billing job will aggregate and apply credit logic post-aggregation.

Risks & trade-offs:
- Complexity for billing infra and accounting (edge cases with partial retries, deduplication).
- Customer mental model: customers used to slabs may be confused by slotless usage spikes. Requires clear console UX and invoice examples.
- Revenue leakage if credit decay windows are misconfigured.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Billing accuracy <0.1% discrepancy vs ground-truth sample for pilot customers.
2) Measured uplift in ARR or no >5% downside vs baseline in 30-day window for pilot customers.
3) QSA artifact pack completed and security answers drafted for top 10 QSA sections.
4) Console examples and invoice preview for pilot customers.
